label: Every accessible contingent concrete existent occurs at some time in its history
paraphrase: OPEN bridge between world-relative existence and temporal presence: every contingent concrete individual existing in an accessible history has at least one moment at which history.IsAt holds. It does not require presence at now or a first moment. It permits timeless necessary concreta and EXCLUDES contingent atemporal concreta: no contingent concrete individual existing in an accessible history is never temporally present there. That exclusion is the work the premise does in result 9e5124a2 (control unmanifestSourceSeparatesTemporal).
